schema_metadata.agent_id: Original immutable A001–A100 research-packet ID; an A ID is not proof of a running worker.
schema_metadata.stream: Original B01–B20 owner, five A packets each. B labels do not add another twenty workers to the 100-role design.
schema_metadata.assignment: Operative task, with mathematical corrections only where noted; original_assignment preserves the original text verbatim.

work_type.description: Explicit role classification distinguishing baseline/interface work, new mathematics, certificates, independent review, and coordination.

priority.description: P0/P1/P2 triage band; readiness and a concrete target govern dispatch. Bands are not mathematical evidence or fixed spending commitments.

bands.P0: Immediate campaign work: closes a primary J/R interface, attacks its unpaid term, certifies a decisive falsifier, or removes a review/execution bottleneck.
bands.P1: Substantial parallel route or class theorem; renew only for a quantitative lemma, a rigorous obstruction, or a necessary review.
bands.P2: Bounded exploratory or formal support; activate only after a concrete target and useful application are identified.

schema_metadata.initial_execution_status: OPEN for every packet in this design. Actual invocation, completion, acceptance, and retirement belong to the separate append-only execution registry.
schema_metadata.mathematical_status: RECOVERED_BASELINE identifies reuse/audit of existing mathematical material, not a completed packet. UNPROVED_TARGET is proposed new work. REVIEW_PENDING, OPERATIONAL_WORK, and PROOF_ASSEMBLY_PENDING do not assert a new theorem.
schema_metadata.gap_id: Initial packet-level target identifier. Each actual attempt must additionally identify the exact versioned mathematical gap it attacks; this design identifier is not an accepted lemma.
schema_metadata.claim_id: Null until an actual result proposes a precisely stated claim; no new claims are created by assignment.
schema_metadata.baseline_source_ids: Entry points to frozen available sources. Before positive reuse read the needed complete original theorem and applicable corrections, recording exact source versions.
schema_metadata.upstream_packets: Advisory reusable reviewed outputs, never hard blockers merely because their A packets have not run. Required_to_start is false. A candidate theorem remains unproved until its actual proof is accepted.
schema_metadata.proof_dependencies: Per-attempt mathematical premises recorded separately from workflow and review routing. Empty initial arrays mean not yet declared, not dependency-free proofs. Accepted proof graphs must be acyclic and may not assume the full FEI target.
schema_metadata.deliverables: Specific artifact descriptions and stable packet-local deliverable IDs; initial OPEN does not duplicate or overwrite preexisting evidence.
schema_metadata.acceptance_criteria: Packet-specific mathematical scope, construction, endpoint, and falsification tests. Meeting a bounded test proves only its stated domain.
schema_metadata.next_consumers: Reverse advisory reuse graph, with the exact interface the receiving packet can consume. It may contain workflow cycles; it is not a proof dependency graph.
schema_metadata.reviewers: Named independent review routes. Contribution history and mathematical scope must be checked at dispatch; recusal overrides a nomination.
schema_metadata.initial_pilot: A small cap in substantive work cycles, with a target-specific renewal milestone. A cycle is one bounded research attempt producing a saved derivation/certificate or exact failed line; it has no assumed token price, model speed, wall-clock duration, or guaranteed execution.
schema_metadata.advisory_method_tags: F-role crosswalk from the concurrent supplement. F labels suggest methods only and create no workers, ownership changes, or scheduled tasks.
schema_metadata.already_available_evidence: Original proof/review receipts eligible for first-instance adoption in the separate live registry. This design does not fabricate a new run or imply all rolling work is complete.

execution_policy.per_natural_run: Each B-stream selects one OPEN/reviewable packet from its own five-packet backlog, adopts any already reviewed baseline needed, resumes its exact current gap, and records packet ID, attempt ID, gap/claim version, work cycles, artifacts, and next action.
execution_policy.baseline_retirement: After one accepted reusable baseline/interface artifact, mark that instance complete in the live registry and move to the next unpaid packet/lemma. Rebuilding known identities is not recurring new-math progress.
execution_policy.no_upstream_barrier: Do not serialize the whole campaign behind upstream packet IDs. Frozen baseline proofs permit independent starts; use reviewed new upstream results when available and keep unproved targets out of assumed premises.
execution_policy.conditional_support: Reviewer, certificate, formalization, and assembly packets need a real target artifact. If no suitable candidate exists, perform a bounded scope/intake action and redeploy to a ready mathematical task without inventing a proof or running irrelevant computation.
execution_policy.review_backpressure: At two READY_FOR_REVIEW candidates, finish existing proofs, resolve review comments, or help an independent review before creating another candidate.
execution_policy.proof_acceptance: A completed attempt with a precise gap is valid saved work, but its mathematical target remains unproved. A finite certificate is accepted only for its certified finite domain; universal promotion needs a proved bridge.
execution_policy.full_fei_gate: A universal FEI proof or disproof requires two independent complete-chain reviews, normally one from B18 and one from B19, by people/agents that did not contribute the claim. Both inspect original proofs, constants, all-dimensional limits, and applicable obstruction controls. Per-packet alternate routing does not substitute for this gate.
execution_policy.recusal: A089/A095 or any other repairer/contributor cannot approve that repaired theorem. B20 records an uninvolved replacement with the necessary scope; review edges never supply mathematical premises.
execution_policy.numerical_policy: Every numerical attempt fixes a lemma/version, actual Boolean family, parameter box, completeness/symmetry scope, case count, measured rate when needed, and CPU/RAM/runtime/case caps. A short initial benchmark may be at most 60 seconds. Enlargement is targeted and bounded, never automatic n→n+1. Use exact Walsh/influence and certified logs for decisive witnesses; stop once the sign is certified.
execution_policy.resource_units: Only work-cycle pilots are allocated here. Actual runtime, capacity, costs, and execution are measured in result records; no token prices or 100-worker continuous capacity are assumed.
execution_policy.public_scope: The campaign plan and research remain in the requested private destinations. This matrix changes neither the already published paper nor any repository, schedule, permission, or external message.

baseline_statements.statement: For actual physical children g,h, q_T=(ĝ(T)^2+ĥ(T)^2)/2, m_T=(|ĝ(T)|−|ĥ(T)|)^2/4, μ=Σm_T, ν_T=m_T/μ. For μ>0, Δ_iH≤μ[log₂(1/μ)−D₂(ν||q)+3/ln2]; μ≤min{I_i,1−I_i}. μ=0 gives Δ_iH=0.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Nonreusing tree payment of Σ_v w_v μ_v[log₂(1/μ_v)−D₂(ν_v||q_v)] plus terminal entropy.

baseline_statements.statement: For F(x,y)=g_x(y), |x|=a, R_T=2^(−a)Σ_b ĝ_b(T)^2, r_T(b)=ĝ_b(T)^2/(2^aR_T), and ν_T the squared normalized Walsh transform across b: B_W=Σ_T R_T H(ν_T), M_W=a−Σ_T R_T H(r_T), Δ_WH=B_W+M_W, 0≤M_W≤(2/ln2)I_W.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: A useful proper-block or whole-tree payment of B_W, or an explicitly structured collision payment. W=all coordinates leaves B_W=H(f).

baseline_statements.statement: With fresh independent selector bits and a proved uniform lower bound c>0 on each neighboring branch disagreement, branch FEI constant C gives multiplexer constant max{2/c,C}.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Admit genuinely new unbounded classes by deriving their structure/c, or control exact collision when c tends to zero.

baseline_statements.statement: The recovered one-bit bent splice has I_sel=2^(−m) and Δ_selH/I_sel≥m−1; universal selector-only Δ_selH≤C I_sel is false.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Existential good-coordinate selection and an appropriately chosen global tree remain open.

baseline_statements.statement: Fixed signed-convolution-order truncations and fixed atom-cap prefixes already admit relevant divergent non-Boolean controls.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: A genuinely additional consequence of full Booleanity with a proved high-degree/conditional payment.

baseline_statements.statement: For normalized reference amplitude b, C_b(U)=Σ_S b_S b_(S△U), v_U=C_b(U)^2, Z=Σ_Uv_U, L=Σ_Uv_U log₂(1/v_U), T=L/Z=H(v/Z)−log₂Z. T is tensor-additive with compatible product completions; fixed raw-L payment is refuted by Boolean tensor powers.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Normalized lower payment and sufficient deficit recovery are separate unproved obligations.

baseline_statements.statement: The weighted-threshold two-branch family already refutes three auxiliary payments: event total correlation, coefficient-one pivotal normalization credit, and even existential conditional-input-TC coordinate payment.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: A replacement corrected-FEI+ proof surviving all three controls. The pivotal-credit result concerns coefficient one only; the conditional-input-TC failure is not the spectral B_i selection problem.

baseline_statements.statement: For disjoint physical derivative-piece supports and signed fiber antichains, a_l=α_l/Σα_l, K_eff=(Σ√a_l)^2, EνG≤2+γ+2 ln K_eff.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Representation admission, all reference normalizers, and the complete derivative-weighted expected cost, including Σ_i I_i ln K_eff,i.

baseline_statements.statement: For fixed weights w_j on complete subprobability references Q_j with full costs b_j, H(P)≤h₂(v)+Σ_{A≠∅}P(A)inf_j[b_j(A)+log₂(1/w_j)].
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Pay the full spectral expectation, including scale selection, variance, roots, and each selected reference's normalizer.

baseline_statements.statement: For the Boolean point defect f_r=1−2 1_{x=x0}, I=2r2^(−r), H_α/I→∞ for every fixed 0<α<1, while Shannon H/I→4.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: Scale-dependent corrected quantities or auxiliary piece Rényi quantities are different statements and must pay their complete cost.

baseline_statements.statement: For every finite K,A,B≥0 an actual Boolean split has L>Kd+AV+BM. This refutes the fixed-price one-node payment only; it does not refute FEI, all adaptive trees, or nonlocal logarithmic transport.
baseline_statements.remaining_open: A physical, nonreusing tree credit paying the logarithmic local debt.
